## Page 15

15Investment Highlights
❖Unique Travel Theme Decorations
“Rich in Unique Concepts Under the ‘Terminal 21’ Brand ” Terminal 21 Asok and Terminal 21 Pattaya are decorated in the style of popular destinations from cities around the World with iconic landmarks recreated inside 
the mall, offering visitors a fun and visually interesting shopping experience .
❖Diverse Shopping Options
Offers a wide variety of shopping options for all tastes and budget 
levels ranging from notable designer brands to local fashion boutiques 
and souvenir shops which can attract both local and foreign shoppers .❖Food Magnets
In addition to having a dedicated floors for Thai and International 
cuisines and cafes, both malls also offer a large Food Court area 
which is known for their affordable and delicious Thai local 
dishes and street food and desserts.
